name: Autosomal Recessive Spastic Paraplegia Type 70

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Genetic Diagnostic Criteria for SPG70

criteria.description: Progressive lower limb spasticity and weakness
Biallelic pathogenic variants in the CAPN1 gene
Exclusion of other causes of hereditary spastic paraplegia
Brain and spinal cord MRI showing no alternative pathology

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive lower limb spasticity and weakness plus genetic confirmation of biallelic CAPN1 pathogenic variants with exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies heavily on genetic testing due to overlapping clinical features with other spastic paraplegias.

laboratory: Exclusion of metabolic causes of spasticity
imaging: Brain and spinal cord MRI typically normal or nonspecific
No evidence of demyelination or structural lesions
other: Electromyography (EMG) and nerve conduction studies may show mild distal sensory neuropathy

distinguishingFeatures: Earlier onset with more prominent cerebellar ataxia
More common and variable clinical presentation

redFlags: Rapid progression over weeks to months
Signs of systemic involvement such as hepatosplenomegaly
references: Orphanet: Autosomal recessive spastic paraplegia type 70 - ORPHA:401835
